provenance.rule: Values are copied from dated repository records or the September 2026 live audit. Missing observations are not imputed.

deployment_snapshot.stamp_service_account_gap: The shared stamp pod automounts the agent service-account token into agent, data-plane, and collector containers.

kernel_microbenchmark.evidence: immutable development artifact; not production or T4 evidence

cost_scenarios.evidence: derived from the 18 Sep Azure retail-price estimate; not invoices
cost_scenarios.current_five_node_caveat: The five-node point reuses the earlier non-GPU fixed-cost assumption although PostgreSQL was later observed on a different SKU.

t4_startup_stages.evidence: retained Kubernetes events and container logs for one Qwen3.5-0.8B model host on an AKS T4 node (docs/model-startup-diagnosis.md); stage boundaries are the recorded UTC timestamps
t4_startup_stages.serving_settings: FP16, context 4096, max-num-seqs 8, gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, eager execution, vLLM 0.26.0

t4_text_only_validation.evidence: isolated validation Job on a spare T4 (docs/model-startup-diagnosis.md); node caches and CPU reservations differed from the retained run, so the difference is not an isolated speedup

routing_benchmark.evidence: simulated model hosts behind the production gateway; citable_as_hardware_measurement is false in every artifact
routing_benchmark.host_model: 4 backends; 2048 blocks x 16 tokens of LRU prefix cache per host; prefill 0.25 ms per uncached token plus 5 ms; decode 16 ms plus 1 ms per running sequence; at most 16 running sequences; time scale 0.25
routing_benchmark.note: Figures read results.json in each sweep directory directly and aggregate per-seed summaries exactly as data-plane/benchmarks/routing/report.py does (arithmetic mean over seeds).

rtx_pro_6000_stamp.enrollment: one-command bootstrap on a single GPU VM running k3s

tool_call_parser_incident.symptom: HTTP 400 on tool-calling requests until a tool-call parser preset was added

live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.vm: single-host Cloud TPU v6e-1 VM (machine type ct6e-standard-1t): 1 chip, 32 GiB HBM
live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.bootstrap: one-command bootstrap detected the TPU from the GCP metadata accelerator-type
live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.agent_measured: 1 x TPU v6e reported by the stamp agent
live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.placement: a deployment was placed on the TPU stamp

defects.symptom: the only catalog TPU preset asked for 4 chips, so a v6e-1 stamp was never offered as a placement
defects.fix: single-chip preset: Qwen3.5 4B bf16 on class tpu-v6e with 1 chip per replica

defects.symptom: libtpu failed at model-host start: TPU initialization failed: Failed to connect to [::]:8353
defects.cause: libtpu reaches its local runtime service over IPv6 loopback, which the IPv4-only pod network lacks
defects.fix: TPU model hosts run with hostNetwork and ClusterFirstWithHostNet DNS; GPU hosts keep the pod network

live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.end_to_end_serving: confirmed after the host-networking fix: the TPU deployment reached Ready and served requests (reported by the authors after re-running the bootstrap on release 57b0fdb; no timing recorded)

routing_policy_split_check.scope: deterministic computation with the shipped routing-policy module; not a measurement
routing_policy_split_check.source: python3 paper/policy_split_check.py at commit 948e673 (choose_target over keys key-0 .. key-99999)

live_observations_2026_11_24_trainium.vm: AWS trn1.2xlarge on the Neuron Deep Learning AMI: 1 Trainium device, 2 NeuronCores, 32 GiB HBM; 100 GiB root volume, later grown to 200 GiB
live_observations_2026_11_24_trainium.bootstrap: one-command bootstrap detected the instance type from EC2 IMDSv2, installed the Neuron device plugin and advertised aws.amazon.com/neuron = 1
live_observations_2026_11_24_trainium.model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B bf16, tensor parallel 2 (NeuronCores), max_model_len 4096, max_num_seqs 4, image pytorch-inference-vllm-neuronx 0.13.0 (SDK 2.28), 8925335190 bytes

defects.symptom: vLLM 0.13 refused to start: 'When prefix caching is enabled, block_size must be set' (pydantic validation of VllmConfig)
defects.cause: vLLM enables prefix caching by default; the Neuron plugin requires an explicit KV block size and a block layout compiled into the model
defects.fix: the operator passes --no-enable-prefix-caching on Neuron unless the deployment's extra args set prefix caching or --block-size (release c0c7149)

defects.symptom: the console reported 'GPU runtime missing' and 'Weight download failed'
defects.cause: vLLM probes for libcuda and logs a harmless ImportError on Neuron; the crash preceded the weight download
defects.fix: the GPU-runtime diagnosis skips Neuron and TPU hosts; configuration errors are reported as 'Server rejected its settings' with vLLM's reason

defects.symptom: after downloading 8.0 GB of weights the model host was evicted (node low on ephemeral-storage) and the next replica was unschedulable (untolerated taint)
defects.cause: the root volume held the AMI's SDK environments (82 GB of 96 GB used) plus the 8.9 GB image, the weights and compiled artifacts, crossing the kubelet eviction threshold
defects.fix: root volume grown to 200 GiB; the console diagnoses disk-pressure evictions and tainted nodes

live_observations_2026_11_24_trainium.end_to_end_serving: observed after the root volume was grown to 200 GiB: the Qwen3-4B deployment served 64 of 64 streamed requests through the edge in the 24 Nov benchmark (silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24)

silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24.scope: single client run through the edge gateway; one sweep, no repetition
silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24.client: Google Colab notebook, region not recorded; all requests through https://<edge>/v1 with streaming
silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24.method: 16 streamed chat completions per concurrency level (1, 4, 8, 16), max_tokens 128, temperature 0, one warm-up request per model; TTFT is client-observed and includes the network path; decode rate is (output tokens - 1) / (end - first token) per request
silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24.caveats: each silicon serves a different model (2B, 4B, 35B-A3B FP8) with its own max_num_seqs, so the run compares deployments, not chips; the network floor was not subtracted

silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24_run2.scope: second client sweep through the edge, same method as the first, with a measured network floor; no further repetition
silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24_run2.network_floor_method: median TTFT of 6 one-token requests ('hi', max_tokens 1) per deployment after one warm-up
silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24_run2.adjustment: network-adjusted throughput = output tokens / max(wall - ceil(N/c) * floor, 0.2 * wall); an approximation
silicon_benchmark_2026_11_24_run2.prefix_cache: not measured: the Colab test prompt (about 12,000 tokens) exceeded the 4,096-token context of three deployments (requests rejected); on the RTX PRO 6000 deployment repeated and unique prefixes gave 1399 and 1398 ms
